tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Hand the work over at a phase boundary. Record what this phase concluded and what the next phase must do, so the work continues with a clean context that no longer carries this phase's process detail. Call it ONLY when a phase is genuinely finished and the remaining work no longer needs the details of how you got here — not to escape a hard problem, and not for a small task that should simply be completed. Call it once. After it returns, do not call any other tool: end your turn.

done.description: What this phase concluded: what was built or found, which files were changed, what was decided and why.

next_task.description: What the next phase must do, and what counts as finished.

keep.description: The facts the next phase must carry over verbatim: paths, symbols, commands, identifiers, test results.

drop.description: Process detail you are deliberately leaving behind. Optional.
